contentHtml:
For the millions of Indian expatriates living and working in the Kingdom, keeping legal documentation up to date is a top priority. As Saudi Arabia continues its digital transformation under Vision 2030, the process for renewing an Indian passport has become more streamlined through the partnership between the Embassy of India in Riyadh, the Consulate General in Jeddah, and VFS Global.

At Connect Resources Saudi, we assist businesses and their international talent in navigating the logistical hurdles of working in the Kingdom. Understanding the current indian passport renewal fee in Saudi Arabia for 2026 is essential for budget planning and avoiding delays in your Iqama renewal.

1. Where to Renew Your Indian Passport in KSA?

In 2026, all Indian passport services are centralized through VFS Global Centres located across major Saudi cities, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Al Khobar, Abha, and Tabuk.

Important: You must book an appointment online via the VFS Global Saudi Arabia website before visiting the center.

2. Indian Passport Renewal Fee in Saudi Arabia (2026 Breakdown)

The total cost for renewal is comprised of the Government Fee, the ICWF Fee, and the VFS Service Charge. Prices are subject to exchange rate fluctuations between the Saudi Riyal (SAR) and the Indian Rupee (INR).

A. Ordinary Passport (36 Pages)

  • Government Fee: Approximately SAR 285

  • VFS Service Charge: ~SAR 17

  • ICWF Fee: ~SAR 8

  • Total Estimated: SAR 310

B. Jumbo Passport (60 Pages)

  • Government Fee: Approximately SAR 380

  • VFS Service Charge: ~SAR 17

  • ICWF Fee: ~SAR 8

  • Total Estimated: SAR 405

C. Minor Passport (Below 15 years)

  • Government Fee: Approximately SAR 190

  • VFS Service Charge: ~SAR 17

  • ICWF Fee: ~SAR 8

  • Total Estimated: SAR 215

3. TATKAL (Emergency) Service Fees

If you need your passport urgently (e.g., for an emergency exit/re-entry or urgent business travel), the TATKAL service is available.

  • Additional TATKAL Premium: Approx. SAR 565 (on top of the standard renewal fee).

  • Processing Time: Usually 2 to 3 working days, subject to approval from the Embassy/Consulate.

4. Required Documents for 2026

To avoid multiple trips to the center, ensure you have the following:

  1. Online Application Form: Printed from the Passport Seva at Indian Embassies and Consulates portal.

  2. Current Passport: Original plus clear photocopies of the first, last, and visa pages.

  3. Iqama: Original and a clear photocopy.

  4. Photographs: Two recent 2×2 inch white background photos (VFS also offers on-site photo services for a small fee).

  5. Proof of Address: This can be your National Address registration in Saudi Arabia.

5. Additional Service Charges at VFS Global

In 2026, VFS Global offers several “Value Added Services” that can increase the final indian passport renewal fee in Saudi Arabia:

Service Estimated Cost (SAR)
Courier Delivery (SMS & Tracking) SAR 30 – 45
Form Filling Assistance SAR 25 – 40
Passport Photo Service SAR 20 – 30
Photocopy Service SAR 1 – 2 per page

6. How Connect Resources Saudi Supports Your Workforce

For companies employing Indian nationals, ensuring that your team’s passports are valid is a critical part of Human Resources and Payroll compliance.

  • Expiration Tracking: We provide automated alerts for Iqama and passport expiry to ensure zero downtime for your employees.

  • EOR Services: Our Employer of Record solutions manage the administrative burden of document renewals, allowing your Indian talent to focus on their professional contributions to your Saudi operations.

7. Conclusion: Plan Ahead

While the indian passport renewal fee in Saudi Arabia remains affordable in 2026, the process can take between 10 to 20 days for standard applications. We recommend starting the renewal process at least six months before your current passport expires to ensure a seamless transition for your Saudi residency status.

FAQ: Indian Passport Renewal in KSA

Q1: Can I pay the fee online?

While you must book the appointment online, the indian passport renewal fee in Saudi Arabia is typically paid at the VFS center via MADA card or cash. Check your appointment confirmation for the latest payment methods.

Q2: What if my Iqama is expired?

If your Iqama is expired, you may face difficulties at the VFS center. You will need a letter from your sponsor or an official printout from the Absher portal showing the status of your renewal.

Q3: Is the “National Address” mandatory for renewal?

Yes. In 2026, the Indian Embassy requires proof of your local Saudi residence, and the registered National Address (Wasel) is the most widely accepted document.
